What we do

Pan-India event management, launches and on-ground brand experiences.

  • Launch events, dealer and partner meets, conferences and on-ground activations.
  • Concept, venue, design, production and on-the-day management.
  • Digital tie-ins: registrations, WhatsApp reminders, live social and post-event content.
